lines.t: Starting to invest at twenty instead of thirty can be worth hundreds of thousands of dollars.
lines.title: 20 VS *30*

lines.t: Two people invest two hundred dollars a month, with a seven percent yearly return, until age sixty-five.
lines.title: $200 / MONTH AT *7%*

lines.t: Alex starts at twenty. Sam starts at thirty.
Alex ends up with around seven hundred fifty-eight thousand dollars. Sam, around three hundred sixty thousand.
lines.title: AT AGE *65*

lines.t: Alex only put in twenty-four thousand dollars more. Compound interest did the rest.
lines.title: TIME > *MONEY*

lines.t: The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is today. Follow for more.
lines.title: START *TODAY*
